packageRules.description: Fleet hold (Jay, Oct 2026): the package named typescript stays the TypeScript 6 API shim (@typescript/typescript6) until typescript-eslint supports the TS 7 compiler API (typescript-eslint#10940). Typecheck runs TypeScript 7 via @typescript/native.
TypeScript 7 native tsc, installed as an npm alias of typescript. Do not collapse this back into the typescript key; that key is the v6 API shim eslint imports.
